reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to the building mechanics in Provincia! Instead of hiding multi-resource costs behind a single chip, each build tile now clearly displays the required materials. You can easily see stored vs required resources, with shortages highlighted for better planning. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
